info.name: Data AVAX Supply Primary Network UTXOs API

params.name: addresses
params.description: A comma separated list of X-Chain or P-Chain wallet addresses, starting with "avax"/"fuji", "P-avax"/"P-fuji" or "X-avax"/"X-fuji".

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: blockchainId
params.description: A primary network blockchain id or alias.

params.name: assetId
params.description: Asset ID for any asset (only applicable X-Chain)

params.name: includeSpent
params.description: Boolean filter to include spent UTXOs.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Which property to sort by, in conjunction with sortOrder.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The order by which to sort results. Use "asc" for ascending order, "desc" for descending order. Sorted by timestamp or the `sortBy` query parameter, if provided.

items.docs: Lists UTXOs on one of the Primary Network chains for the supplied addresses.
